articleHook: The article names Apple, Nike, Volkswagen, Google and BMW as examples of restrained logos, but none of the images on the page carry a caption showing which logo is meant.
It puts YouTube at a 20% average citation share against 0.1% for Vimeo, with a 200x call-out, but the page has no chart or video to show those figures.
It explains SEO, AEO and GEO in text only, and the single image is a stock photo of a developer at a computer, with no diagram showing how the three fit together.
It defines a journey map as 'a visual representation' of every stage, then shows the five stages only as a text table, with no actual map graphic.
The title appears twice as a top level heading, and the six criteria are all text, with no scorecard or comparison graphic to use in vendor conversations.
Under 'Ideal Customer Profile Example' the table shown is headed 'Demand generation vs lead generation', not an ICP example, and no ICP graphic appears anywhere in the post.
Key Takeaways says Frese Recruiting claims 'Over 500 physiotherapists trust us', but the Frese write-up in the same post says 'Over 400 physiotherapists trust us'.
Section 3 says to turn a post into an infographic and a short-form video, but the piece has neither, and one image caption has the typo "startegy".
It explains Scribble diagrams, equation support and Quiz Me, but only with static screenshots, and there is no video showing any of them working in a lecture.
It cites Gartner saying 80% of B2B sales interactions "will occur in digital channels by 2025", still in future tense in a piece dated May 15, 2026.
It shows the rise from 1.2 percent of vacancies in 2022 to 3.4 percent in 2026 only as static PNG charts, five in all, with no animated or video version.
The Impact at a glance section lists six results, including a 25% uplift in pass rates and onboarding cut from 2-3 days to under 24 hours, as plain bullets with no chart or video.
In step 6 you say the video strategy is "another whole YouTube video" and suggest reusing Meta or TikTok ads, so this written guide has no Demand Gen video example.
Your recap of the sold-out 6 November Intelligence Series panel is all text with one event photo, and there is no clip or graphic from the panel itself.
The page carries two bylines, voltix and Digma, and its footer social links point to EmpireElec accounts on Facebook and X rather than MediaOne.
The title is repeated as a second heading ('The Best YouTube Video Editors for Healthcare Marketing in 2025'), and the Animaker pick is called best for medical explainers without showing one.
The 'Video marketing' section shows a still image rather than a video, and the Account-Based Marketing section ends with 'AMB might be a strategy to explore' instead of ABM.
The 'Keywords still work … when used right' heading has no number, so the numbered headings jump from 2 to 4, and the intro list words rule 5 differently from its heading.
The Consumption Gap graphic is still served from spearmarketing.wpengine.com, and the thank you page plus fulfilment email flow the article recommends has no mock-up or example to show it.
The "Email this Page" share link on it actually points to an X share URL, and the 62% and 70% survey stats sit as plain text with no chart or video.

The only image is a header captioned "If AI hasn't clicked yet" whose alt text describes a blackboard of website development trends, which has nothing to do with AI, and the piece has no other visuals.

Two pull quotes are marked up as H2 headings and repeat sentences from the paragraphs just above them, including "Just switch it on and we'll make it happen". The share links also use a different title.
The table of contents block shows placeholder text, "This is some text inside of a div block.", and the guide has no diagram or visual beyond one header image.
